justificativa: The candidate removes the monkey-patch but migrates only three call sites (PDF helper, professor affiliations, scholarity label). It leaves many dates that would now render in ISO format: edit_date_column, enrollment request comments, the admission_date log message, the custom_forms and admissions index views, and _show_dismissal. Worse, the scholarity edit form's text_field would emit an ISO date that its own DD/MM/YYYY validation rejects.
